name: send_tracking_sms
description: Send a transactional order status/tracking text message to the phone number already on the verified Shopify order. Only call after the caller asks for a text or agrees to receive the order update by SMS.

request_body_schema.description: Verified order details for sending a transactional SMS

properties.name: customer_email
properties.description: The email address used at checkout. Required unless customer_phone is provided.

properties.name: customer_phone
properties.description: The phone number used at checkout. Required unless customer_email is provided. This is for verification only; the API sends only to the phone number already on the order.

properties.name: conversation_id
properties.description: Optional ElevenLabs conversation identifier if available.
